research_question: After a verified immutable wheel exists, is extraction itself necessary for a pure-Python runtime projection?
canonical_build: Build wheel from an isolated temporary source projection so backend residue cannot mutate the canonical repository.
artifact_integrity: Recompute and compare SHA-256 before every reconstruction.
hard_safety_boundary: No privileged writes, OS-global cache drop, boot/config mutation, filesystem-wide mutation, or system package-manager mutation.
